skills.name: brief-intake
skills.description: Turn the user's request (brand + product, optional competitors and settings) into a complete research brief. Step 1 of the content benchmark run.

skills.name: competitor-discovery
skills.description: Find (or check) the brand's competitors and every link where their content lives - website, Instagram, Facebook page, YouTube channel, Meta Ad Library and Google Ads Transparency pages. Step 2; needs user approval.

skills.name: creative-collection
skills.description: Collect the strongest recent creatives (paid ads and organic posts, photo and video) for each approved competitor plus the brand's own as a baseline, with selection evidence, media, 1-2 fps video frames, cut times and transcripts. Step 3.

skills.name: creative-analysis
skills.parallel: per creative: 2 analysts (B, S) + 1 checker, then a resolver
skills.description: Analyse one creative on the 54 benchmark parameters - evidence first, measured facts before eye judgement - for each the evidence, finding, option and where it sits (shot for video, layer, assets); a Business analyst and a Style analyst split the work and an independent checker re-reads it. Step 4; run per creative.

skills.name: benchmark-synthesis
skills.description: Turn all creative analyses into a short note per competitor, market patterns per parameter (what most do, what few do) and 3-5 headline findings. Step 5.

skills.name: content-recommendation
skills.description: Recommend content ideas for the brand on the same benchmark parameters, based on competitor patterns and gaps, and write the final benchmark report. Step 6.

skills.name: report-review
skills.description: Check the finished run before calling it done - ids, counts and evidence agree across files, every recommendation is grounded, links open, nothing is guessed - fix what fails and record the review. Step 7.
